hint_ladder: Add a polite check to what you are doing or asking.
The frame can close a statement or open a request, and mind is negative there.
Start with the words: I'll take this one, if you don't ___.
teaching_content.reveal_form: I'll take this one, if you don't mind.
canonical_forms: I'll take this one, if you don't mind.
alternative_realizations: If you don't mind, I'll open the window.
